data: What is the maximum value of the density function after 100 iterations of extended Baum-Welch across all standard deviations?

The blue line represents the densities of the scaled standard deviations before 100 iterations of extended Baum-Welch, while the black line represents the densities after 100 iterations. The y-axis shows the density values, and the x-axis shows the standard deviation values ranging from approximately 0.0 to 2.0. The peak of the black line appears to be slightly higher than the peak of the blue line, indicating an increase in density after 100 iterations. The maximum value of the density function after 100 iterations can be estimated visually as approximately 1.5.
